name: AI Pathfinder Inc Limited
ownership_summary: Holding-company SIC code (64209); incorporated 23 May 2025, four months before the £15bn announcement, with no accounts filed (first due Feb 2027). Press reporting describes an Isle of Man holding company formed mid-2025 as the founding shareholder, a ~£100m seed round at a £500m valuation in November 2025, an asset freeze during shareholder litigation, and a £17.7m management buyout in January 2026 upheld by the High Court on 24 July 2026.
notes: A sibling entity, AI PATHFINDER HOLDINGS LIMITED (16926656), was incorporated 22 Dec 2025 at the same registered office (58 Grosvenor Street, London W1K 3JB) — timing consistent with the reported management buyout restructuring. City A.M. reports the operating business effectively ceased after the buyout.

name: Salamanca Group
ownership_summary: London property development and investment firm chaired by Martin Bellamy, co-founder of AI Pathfinder. Press described AI Pathfinder as a Salamanca subsidiary/affiliate; the exact corporate relationship was never documented publicly and Companies House shows AI Pathfinder Inc Limited as a standalone holding company.
notes: Recorded as reported association, not verified ownership.

name: North Ayrshire Council
notes: Also economic development lead for the i3 Enterprise Area and likely owner of serviced i3 plots. Publicly welcomed the announcement in September 2025 (Cllr Tony Gurney); its news page on the investment returned 404 by July 2026.

name: Stop Climate Chaos Scotland
notes: Coalition (chair Mike Robinson; member Action to Protect Rural Scotland, Dr Kat Jones) urging the First Minister to block the project, warning of grid strain, higher bills, potential blackouts and carbon-budget impacts.
